is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.s. (Page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-w), Vgsc L995S (kdr-e), Ace-1 G280S (G119S), GSTe2 L119F, and Rdl A296S (Page 4, Table 1; Page 6, Section 3.6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 provides genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) for kdr-w, kdr-e, and Ace-1 in An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. (Page 4).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Bangui, Central African Republic (Page 2, Section 2.1).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original research article reporting new field data (Page 1).

sub_country_location.evidence: Samples were collected in two neighborhoods: Gbanikola and Taoka St Paul in Bangui (Page 2, Section 2.1).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection in 2016.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype data is provided in Table 1 and Table 2.

assessment.summary: This study characterizes insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus s.s. from Bangui, Central African Republic. It reports high resistance to pyrethroids and DDT, and genotypes kdr (L1014F/S), Ace-1, GSTe2 L119F, and Rdl A296S markers.
